summary: Houthi attacks on Saudi airports killed 12 and injured 309, prompting U.S. embassy restrictions and Saudi-Iranian diplomatic engagement. Iran conducted a large-scale ballistic missile drill while dismissing U.S. concessions on Hormuz as inadequate. Israel remains on high alert for potential Iranian strikes and eliminated a senior Hamas commander in Khan Yunis.
key_points: Houthi attacks on King Khalid and King Fahd airports killed 12 civilians of multiple nationalities and injured 309. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8205)
Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan spoke with Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi about de-escalation after 13 civilian deaths from Houthi attacks. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8214)
Iran conducted a ballistic missile and drone drill with dozens of missiles, its first since the "Great Prophet" operation. (Source: @kianmeli1/93251)
Israeli military is on high alert preparing for three scenarios: independent strike on Iran, joint U.S. operation, or defense against Iranian missiles. (Source: @kianmeli1/93254)
U.S. returned approximately 20 tanker aircraft to Europe amid Iran tensions and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. (Source: @New_security8200/204196)
A ship was attacked by a UAV near Sohar port, Oman, with crew evacuated. (Source: @asafroz/54251)
IDF eliminated Hamas Nukhba company commander Hasham Abu Ghalala in Khan Yunis, who led Kissufim outpost raid and participated in Oct 7 kidnappings. (Source: @idf_telegram/25335)
Saudi interceptor missile stocks are depleting against Houthi attacks, per Saudi officials. (Source: @N12chat/229555)

sections.executive_summary: Houthi attacks on Saudi airports killed 12 and injured 309, prompting U.S. embassy restrictions and Saudi-Iranian diplomatic engagement. Iran conducted a large-scale ballistic missile drill while dismissing U.S. concessions on Hormuz as inadequate. points: Iran conducted a ballistic missile and drone drill involving dozens of ballistic missiles, marking its first such exercise since the "Great Prophet" operation, signaling restored combat readiness. (Source: @kianmeli1/93251)

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi proposed to Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan to assist in reducing tensions with the Houthis, indicating Tehran's willingness to mediate. (Source: @N12chat/229560)

SNSC Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaei dismissed the U.S. response to Iran's seven conditions for resolving the conflict as "inadequate," stating Washington agreed to only some conditions regarding the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @presstv/210401, @amitsegal/65683)
Iranian media threatened the UAE with "scenarios" for its "long tongue" provocations, suggesting potential retaliation against Emirati interests. (Source: @kianmeli1/93244)
An unspecified incident occurred in Karaj, Alborz Province at 1450Z, though details remain unclear. (Source: @shin_persian/10983)

Israeli military placed on highest alert level preparing for three scenarios: independent attack on Iran, joint U.S.-Israeli operation, or defense against Iranian missile barrages. (Source: @kianmeli1/93254)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas Nukhba company commander Hasham Jamal Muhammad Abu Ghalala in Khan Yunis, who led the Kissufim outpost raid and participated in October 7 kidnappings. (Source: @idf_telegram/25335)
IDF forces in southern Gaza identified and eliminated a terrorist who crossed the "yellow line" posing an immediate threat, operating under the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @New_security8200/204202)

IDF exposed extensive Hamas military use of Kamal Adwan Hospital in Jabalia, including armed militants, weapon storage, and booby-trapped areas, with 240+ militants arrested in December 2024. (Source: @New_security8200/204193)
Prime Minister Netanyahu convened a security assessment with defense chiefs focusing on Iranian threats amid rising regional tensions. (Source: @New_security8200/204198)
IDF fired an interceptor at a suspicious aerial target in southern Lebanon where forces are operating; interception results under review, no alerts activated. (Source: @idf_telegram/25338)
Israel plans a military exercise at Dead Sea hotel area in Tamar and Megilot regional councils, with heavy vehicle movement and live fire expected. (Source: @New_security8200/204201)
IDF eliminated a terrorist in southern Gaza who crossed the "yellow line" in an immediate threat, continuing operations under the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @New_security8200/204202)

Kamal Adwan Hospital in Jabalia, northern Gaza, remains a central Hamas hub used for terror planning, weapons storage, and human shielding, per IDF intelligence and documentation. (Source: @New_security8200/204193)
Hamas Nukhba commander Hasham Abu Ghalala, involved in October 7 kidnappings and Kissufim raid, was killed in Khan Yunis by Israeli airstrike. (Source: @idf_telegram/25335)

Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich accused Supreme Court justices of endangering security by ordering accelerated return of West Bank refugee camp residents, claiming it rebuilds terror infrastructure. (Source: @amitsegal/65698)
IDF fired an interceptor at a suspicious aerial target in southern Lebanon where Israeli forces operate; results under review, no sirens activated. (Source: @idf_telegram/25338)
Artillery shelling reported in Nabatieh al-Fawqa area, per live map. (Source: @redlinkleb/47659)
"Resistance Axis" media referenced operations in Iraq with metaphorical "Titanic" imagery, suggesting escalating militia activity. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82324)
